records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Ana,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:31a1fe0c, email:59aa74d1) or tickets. Pro plan and active subscription suggest some intent, but total silence over 8 remaining days makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Checking in after my welcome note last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating one project is the easiest first step 
into seeing how it fits your team. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
